C-SEC-STREAM-AUTH.IntentSummary: Fence disabled extensions and foreign owners at the stream mutation boundary. Approval is the owner's instruction to implement the reviewed Markdown plan on 2026-11-11; the plan's corresponding task defines the detailed behavior and regression matrix.

T-001.Title: Fence disabled extensions and foreign owners at the stream mutation boundary

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: A retained credential cannot authorize any stream operation after disable.
Only the enabled session owner may resynchronize; foreign conflicts disclose no session ID.
Disable, mutation and ordered session-epoch events share a synchronization boundary.
